integrity: Exact arithmetic replay of all displayed test cases; mathematical proof supplies unrestricted quantification. No independent mathematical or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary free nilpotent Lie algebras on exactly two generators over finite fields; labeled nonsingular derivations. Does not count singular ranks, automorphism orbits, determinant fibers, or derivations of general quotients. Class-two specialization is already known; the all-class characteristic threshold and plateau are assessed here. Broader Lie-power literature could affect publication priority.
title: A sharp \(2p\) obstruction and spectral plateaus for nonsingular derivations of free rank-two nilpotent Lie algebras
